title: Matariki public holiday information
text: Matariki is the Māori name for the Pleiades star cluster. In Aotearoa New Zealand, Matariki is observed as a public holiday with community events, remembrance, celebrating the present, and planning for the future.

title: Te reo Māori language resources
text: Te reo Māori is an official language of New Zealand. Beginner resources include pronunciation guides, everyday phrases, and information about tikanga Māori, customs and values.

title: Regional search and local context
text: A local search service can improve discovery of community information by indexing trusted regional sources and respecting local vocabulary, spelling, and context.

title: Hybrid information retrieval
text: BM25 is a sparse term-matching ranking function. Dense retrieval encodes queries and documents as vectors. Hybrid retrieval combines lexical and semantic evidence to improve search coverage.

title: Conversational clarification
text: A conversational search assistant may ask a focused follow-up question when a query has multiple plausible interpretations. Unnecessary questions add friction, so retrieval confidence can inform routing.

title: Research evaluation metrics
text: Information retrieval systems are commonly evaluated using precision at one, mean reciprocal rank, normalized discounted cumulative gain, and recall at a cutoff. Evaluation requires topics and relevance judgments.

title: Bicultural community media
text: Community media may contain local place names, bilingual expressions, and culturally specific references. Responsible search evaluation should document sources, permissions, and limitations.
